summary: Backend tests for the new Kajabi-gated magic-link subscription layer. 18/18 pytest cases pass covering /api/auth/me, magic-link request/verify (valid, reuse, expired, rate-limit, invalid email), 401 gating on /api/tts, /api/scenes/upload, /api/scenes/{id}/download-lines, trial exhaustion (402 with detail.code=trial_exhausted, kind=word|scene), active-membership bypass with counters not incrementing, Kajabi /webhook (missing/wrong token 401, purchase creates membership + shell user + webhook_events row, replay returns duplicate:true and does not create a second membership, payment_succeeded refreshes last_payment_at + last_event), and /kajabi/cancel with future vs past subscription_end_at flipping /api/auth/me subscription_status between active and none. /api/caption-search remains ungated. Test data cleaned up in module teardown.

minor.issue: Invalid-email requests return 422 (Pydantic EmailStr) instead of the spec-stated 400 invalid_email; the explicit regex/HTTPException(400) branch is unreachable because Pydantic validates first. Cosmetic — either accept the 422 in docs or switch the model field to str and rely on EMAIL_RE.

action_items: Optional: align invalid-email response to 400 invalid_email (currently 422 from Pydantic EmailStr) if the frontend/spec expects that exact contract.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: EMAIL_RE validation after Pydantic EmailStr is dead code — EmailStr already rejects malformed input with 422 before the regex runs.

auth.py ensure_indexes(): TTL index is created on `expires_at_dt` but magic_links documents only store `expires_at` (ISO string) — TTL never fires, magic_links will grow forever. Either write a real BSON date field or use a background cleanup.

kajabi.py webhook: token is read from a query parameter; if a proxy strips query strings on POST or logs them, the secret can leak. Consider also accepting a header (e.g. X-Webhook-Token) since Kajabi's URL is user-configurable.

kajabi.py webhook: DuplicateKeyError detection uses class-name string match (exc.__class__.__name__). Prefer `from pymongo.errors import DuplicateKeyError` and `except DuplicateKeyError` for clarity/robustness.
server.py > 1100 lines — recommend splitting scenes/tts/turns routes into separate modules for maintainability.
test_credentials: Magic-link tokens seeded directly into db.magic_links; test emails use TEST_*@example.org prefix.
seed_data_creation: Per-test TEST_*@example.org users, memberships, magic_links, and webhook_events rows — all cleaned up in module-scope teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_subscription_auth.py is idempotent, uses direct pymongo writes for magic-link tokens (Resend test-mode friendly), cleans up TEST_ data, and covers all 18 review scenarios. Rerun with `pytest backend/tests/test_subscription_auth.py -v`.
